verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a SaaS travel and expense platform like Navan, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, regional hosting, or region selection. The MCP, API and product docs cover data access and features only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
